key_points: Berenberg downgraded Nike to Strong Sell.
After‑hours slide ~9% on soft full‑year forecast; CEO says recovery will take time.
Multiple sell ratings and price‑target cuts from Barclays, Goldman Sachs, etc.
Some bullish commentary cites generational buying opportunity and retail support.
Stock near 52‑week lows with high dividend yield but turnaround appears stalled.
